{{Quote|Thousands of grand moffs, evil warlords, stormtroopers, Imperial droids, and enemy officers from the Empire are arriving at Kessendra Stadium on Kessel for a big gathering in their capital city.|Mon Mothma|<ref name="godv" />}}
The '''Kessendra Coronation''' was held in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] in the open-air [[Kessendra Stadium]] on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. It was organized by the [[Central Committee of Grand Moffs]] to reveal the existence of their champion [[Trioculus]], the [[Supreme Slavelord]] of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. They intended to introduce him as the three-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] son of the late [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], bringing him forward as the rightful ruler of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in opposition to [[Ysanne Isard]], [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]]. For the occasion, thousands of [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]], [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Slavery/Legends|slavelords]], and even slaves were summoned in the Kessendra Stadium. Unbeknownst to the Imperials, the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] had been sent by the enemy [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to spy on the event. Despite initial resistance from a [[Unidentified Royal Guard|Royal Guard]] and a [[Grand Admiral/Legends|grand admiral]], Trioculus ended up mustering support from the majority of the assembly. Now considered the ruler of the Empire by many, Trioculus started to campaign against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Background==
{{Quote|There seems to be much controversy about the latest prophecy of the Supreme Prophet of the Dark Side, Kadann.|Mon Mothma|<ref name="godv" />}}
[[File:Emperor_Palpatine_TNsR.jpg|thumb|left|Palpatine's demise created a power vacuum in the Empire.]]
In the wake of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the dreaded [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had been defeated by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] after a [[Standard year/Legends|year]]-long conflict known as the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Not only its [[Death Star II/Legends|second]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] had been destroyed, but its leaders, the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], were [[Death/Legends|dead]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> While the [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] officially took control of the Empire, his right to rule was almost immediately contested. Many other Imperials declared themselves independent. After a sixth-month reign, Pestage's command was circumvented by [[Ysanne Isard]], [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]]. While Isard succeeded in maintaining the Empire and fending off aggressive warlords for a time, a majority of the Empire's [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moffs]] united under the banner of the [[Central Committee of Grand Moffs]], in an attempt to subvert her claim to rule the Empire.<ref name="TNEC" />

Since rumors had long circulated that the late Palpatine had sired a three-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] [[mutant]] son, [[Bertroff Hissa]], the unspoken leader of the Central Committee, sought to use these superstitions. The Grand Moffs conspired with [[Trioculus]], Hissa's lifelong protégé and [[Supreme Slavelord]] of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], under the pretense that he was indeed Palpatine's long-lost heir. Meanwhile, the so-called [[Supreme Prophet]] [[Kadann]]&mdash;who had in fact been replaced by a [[Bimm/Legends|Bimm]] con artist named [[Rajah Ubooki]]&mdash;revealed the existence of the indestructible [[Glove of Darth Vader|right-hand glove]] of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], claiming that only the man who could locate that glove and wear it would rule the Empire. Although Ubooki and his Prophets were frauds, their [[Church of the Dark Side]] had been created to entice the Imperial populace, and the Bimm's "prophecies" had powerful influence.<ref name="SPINblog" />

==The Coronation==
{{Quote|Friends of the Empire, I present to you the son of Emperor Palpatine&mdash;Trioculus, the Supreme Slavelord of Kessel!|Bertroff Hissa|<ref name="godv" />}}
[[File:UnlimitedPowahJunior-GODVp22.png|thumb|right|150px|Trioculus chastizes two dissenters.]]
Almost as soon as the general public heard of the glove of Darth Vader, the Central Committee decided to hold a massive gathering in the [[Kessendra Stadium|stadium]] of [[Kessendra]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], intent on using the place to promote their proposed champion for the Imperial throne.<ref name="SPINblog" /> The Central Committee summoned thousands of attendants from all the levels of the Imperial hierarchy, from the decorated [[Warlord of the Empire|warlords]] and [[Grand Admiral/Legends|grand admirals]] to the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and lower-ranking [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]]. Even the [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were invited, along with their overseers. Unbeknownst to the Imperials, the enemy [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] acquired intelligence that the gathering would take place through its [[Senate Planetary Intelligence Network]]. Because of that, the New Republic [[Droid/Legends|droid]] partners [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were [[Mission to Kessel (Trioculus affair)|sent]] to the Kessendra Stadium disguised as Kessel [[Mining droid|mining units]] so they could spy on the gathering.<ref name="godv" />

Grand Moff Hissa revealed that the rumored son of Palpatine did exist, and that he had lived on Kessel for years. Upon the announcement, the audience collectively gasped in awe, and a grand admiral inquired about the identity of the alleged Imperial heir. Supreme Slavelord Trioculus then made a dramatic entrance, which plunged the ceremony's attendants into silent terror. Trioculus then delivered a brief speech, insisting on the continuity between the reign of his "[[Parent/Legends|father]]" and his future rule. When Hissa ordered the gathered Imperials to bow and accept their new Emperor, a [[Unidentified Royal Guard|certain]] [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guard]] stood up in the crowd. The Guard objected there were others who claimed to be the new ruler of the Empire, including Grand Admiral [[Josef Grunger]]. Almost immediately, a grand admiral rose and expressed his concerned that Trioculus did not wear the Glove of Darth Vader, as the prophecy required. In response, the Supreme Slavelord invoked his purported [[Force lightning/Legends|lightning power]] of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]]" to [[Torture/Legends|torture]] the two dissenters. That display of mystic force had an immediate impact on the attendants, who pressed to pledge their loyalty to him. What the audience did not know was that their new Emperor was not even [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and wore a [[Trioculus' lightning device|implanted device]] that allowed him to shoot lightning bolts.<ref name="godv" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Find me the glove of Darth Vader!|The seven words of Trioculus to his Grand Moffs|<ref name="godv" />}}
[[File:Central_Committee.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Central Committee of Grand Moffs listens to the seven words of Trioculus.]]
While the bulk of the shattered [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]&mdash;including Captain [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] and his [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']]&mdash;remained loyal to Isard,<ref name="TNEC" /> a significant number of Imperials still ranged themselves under Trioculus' banner. Following the success of the Coronation, the new Emperor met the Grand Moffs and the Grand Admiral [[Miltin Takel]] in [[Trioculus' Palace|his palace]]. Since many pro-Imperial citizens had faith in the pseudo Kadann's prophecy, the new Emperor ordered the Moffs to begin a galaxy-wide search for the lost glove of Vader in order to gain the support of the self-proclaimed Prophet. At the same time, he tasked the Moffs with finding a location for his new headquarters and started [[Trioculus affair|campaigning]] against the burgeoning [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="godv" /> In the meantime, unbeknownst to even the Central Committee, Palpatine had [[Essence transfer|returned to life]] in a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] body on the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] world of [[Byss/Legends|Byss]]. Through the Church of the Dark Side and Sate Pestage, he manipulated Trioculus, filling him with dreams of grandeur. In reality, the mutant slavelord was merely a lightning rod to distract the New Republic while the original Galactic Emperor kept hiding in a [[Emperor's Citadel|secret citadel]], preparing the rise of a new [[Dark Empire]].<ref name="SPINblog" />
